note: Real-child playtest observation schema (Stage 7/8 §18). Factory PASS = AI_VERIFIED only; real engagement stays REAL_CHILD_VALIDATION_PENDING until observations accumulate here. Append one JSON object per child x game session to child-observations.jsonl. Feed results back via /game-lab improve <gameType> (attach the relevant observation lines to the improvement project's redesign-proposals.md section 1).
title: ChildObservation

confusion_points.description: where the child got stuck / misread the UI / misunderstood the goal

spontaneous_replay.description: did the child replay WITHOUT being asked

asked_for_help.description: times the child asked an adult

engagement_signals.description: optional: leaning in, narrating, showing others, ignoring distractions...

map_observation.description: §35 World Map Lab: home/region-map observation for the same session. AI_VERIFIED_MAP stays REAL_CHILD_MAP_VALIDATION_PENDING until these accumulate.

first_tap.description: 地図で最初に押した場所（world名/地区チップ/霧の地区/その他）

panned_map.description: 地図をドラッグ/スワイプで動かしたか

zoom_understood.description: 地区タップ→ズームの動きを迷わず使えたか

explored_beyond_signals.description: 光っている(シグナル)以外のworldも自分から開いたか

fog_reaction.description: 霧の地区(？)への反応（押した/聞いた/無視/こわがった）

returned_home_unaided.description: world体験後、助けなしで地図に戻れたか

map_words.description: 地図について子どもが発した言葉（例:「まだあるの？」）
